structural_signature: Rendering requires a spatial resolution step: the system extracts positions of referents in the scene and lays out output at those coordinates, so an output element's location is a function of scene geometry rather than of a layout slot. Losing tracking loses placement, not content.

pattern_name: a generative pipeline interposed between the scene and the user's view
short_summary: A chain of generative transformations is placed inside the user's perceptual path, so that what the user perceives is the pipeline's reconstruction rather than the captured signal.
ui_ux_rationale: Makes a generative reconstruction the user's continuous perceptual surface.
definition: A chain of generative transformations is placed inside the user's perceptual path, so that what the user perceives is the pipeline's reconstruction rather than the captured signal. The original signal is not shown alongside; it is displaced, and the mediation is continuous and unavoidable while the system is worn or running. The category covers both readings of that arrangement: the plain control-flow case, where the pipeline simply sits between the scene and the display; and the case where the arrangement exists so that a property of the model is conveyed by making the user *undergo* its effects on their own perception rather than by describing, plotting or explaining it. Where a paper states only the experiential purpose, the interposed pipeline is still what is coded.
structural_signature: Capture → transform₁ → … → transformₙ → display, wired in series with no bypass: the sensor's output never reaches the display directly, and the display shows only the terminal transform's output. The chain typically crosses representations (signal → symbolic → signal), and the loss at each crossing is what the user perceives. Transplants to audio (mic → transcript → resynthesis → earpiece), text streams, or any sensed-and-displayed channel. For the experiential reading the same wiring holds, with one additional negative residue: no explanatory or visualization element for the model property being conveyed appears anywhere in the interface.

pattern_name: multiple input modalities and gestures accepted together
short_summary: Two or more physically distinct input channels — typed text, drawn marks, speech, pointing, body pose, GUI controls — are accepted for the same operation.
ui_ux_rationale: Combines or interchanges text, speech, drawing, pointing, pose, and GUI input.
definition: Two or more physically distinct input channels — typed text, drawn marks, speech, pointing, body pose, GUI controls — are accepted for the same operation. They are either fused into one request or freely interchangeable within a single interaction, without a mode change.
structural_signature: The input side of one operation has at least two capture channels feeding a single request object, and the system must fuse or arbitrate between them. The user can switch channels mid-operation without transitioning the interface to a different state, so channel choice is not a mode.

pattern_name: physical objects and physical space as the input or output channel
short_summary: At least one end of the interaction loop lives in matter rather than pixels: objects are grasped, moved, or posed to issue commands, or the system's output is delivered as physical motion, staged space, or a tangible arrangement.
ui_ux_rationale: Uses tangible objects, movement, or spatial arrangements as interface elements.
definition: At least one end of the interaction loop lives in matter rather than pixels: objects are grasped, moved, or posed to issue commands, or the system's output is delivered as physical motion, staged space, or a tangible arrangement. The screen is displaced from that end of the loop.
structural_signature: Either the sensed event that constitutes a command is a physical manipulation of an object or body in space, or the emitted result is actuation or placement in space with no rendered layer required. The interface's layout is described in room coordinates, zones, and objects rather than in windows and widgets.

pattern_name: spoken channel as the interaction surface in place of typed input
short_summary: The user drives the system by speaking, and the spoken utterance occupies the slot that a typed prompt or a direct-manipulation action would otherwise occupy.
ui_ux_rationale: Makes speech the operative command or prompting channel.
definition: The user drives the system by speaking, and the spoken utterance occupies the slot that a typed prompt or a direct-manipulation action would otherwise occupy. The system's other controls may still exist, but the contributed interaction is that speech is the channel through which intent enters. Papers in this group either build voice as the sole authoring channel or interrogate what happens when voice is collapsed onto the text pipeline.
structural_signature: An audio-capture channel is the entry point of the control flow; the utterance is converted to an internal command, instruction sequence, or code, and that conversion product is what the rest of the system consumes. Nothing else in the flow requires the user to touch a pointer or keyboard, and the surface that would normally accept typed or pointed input is either absent or bypassed.

pattern_name: the same content delivered in more than one modality
short_summary: One unit of system output is rendered in two or more sensory or representational channels at once — text plus speech, text plus image plus sound, or one language plus another.
ui_ux_rationale: Presents equivalent content through multiple sensory or representational channels.
definition: One unit of system output is rendered in two or more sensory or representational channels at once — text plus speech, text plus image plus sound, or one language plus another. The channels carry the same content rather than complementary content, so the user may take up whichever channel suits them. The duplication is deliberate and built into the generation or rendering step.
structural_signature: A single output item fans out to multiple renderers whose products are presented together (concurrently or in immediate succession), each renderer targeting a different channel. The channels are redundant with respect to content: removing one loses a way of receiving the item but not the item itself.

pattern_name: nonvisual sequential navigation through structure
short_summary: A structured artifact is exposed as a traversable graph of positions that the user steps through with discrete commands, with the system's response delivered on a nonvisual channel.
ui_ux_rationale: Supports traversal of structured content using nonvisual commands and positional feedback.
definition: A structured artifact is exposed as a traversable graph of positions that the user steps through with discrete commands, with the system's response delivered on a nonvisual channel. Position within the structure is announced, so the user's location is part of the output rather than something read off a display. The artifact is not flattened into a single linear description.
structural_signature: The artifact is parsed into addressable nodes (items, points, layers, regions); the input surface is a small set of discrete move commands (next, previous, into, out of) plus queries; each move emits a nonvisual rendering of the node reached together with an orientation cue naming where in the structure that node sits. The load-bearing property is the *persistent cursor*: state is carried between commands so the same key means different things at different positions. Transplants to any structured content and any nonvisual channel — a directory tree read aloud, a menu stepped through by haptics.

pattern_name: screenless task delegation with no visual interface
short_summary: The user hands a whole multi-step task to the system through a non-visual act and then stops attending to it; there is no display at any point in the loop.
ui_ux_rationale: Uses a nonvisual handoff as the complete interface to a multi-step task.
definition: The user hands a whole multi-step task to the system through a non-visual act and then stops attending to it; there is no display at any point in the loop. Nothing is shown during execution, and the user cannot inspect progress. The handoff is complete at the moment of the request.
structural_signature: The interaction consists of an initiation gesture, a specification uttered on a non-visual channel, and a terminating signal, with no display surface in the loop and no intermediate state exposed. Structurally this forbids monitoring, mid-flight correction, and selection among alternatives: the control flow has exactly one user decision point, at the start. Transplants to any delegation without a display — a button on a wearable, a voice command to an appliance.

pattern_name: the material rewritten as human-readable text
short_summary: Material that is not prose — extracted data, code, an algorithmic sequence, a probability, a structure — is converted into natural language and delivered in that form.
ui_ux_rationale: Turns non-prose information into a readable language surface.
definition: Material that is not prose — extracted data, code, an algorithmic sequence, a probability, a structure — is converted into natural language and delivered in that form. The prose is the output surface the user actually reads. The conversion is the design move: the same information was already available in a non-verbal form.
structural_signature: A non-prose source representation exists in the system, and a rendering step maps it to running natural language that is placed in the user-facing slot. The mapping is one-way and terminal: the prose is what the user consumes, and any downstream action is taken on the prose rather than on the source. The source may remain visible alongside, but the prose does not need to be re-parsed to be used.

pattern_name: abstract output given a viewable rendered representation
short_summary: The model produces output in a representation the user cannot perceive directly — parameter streams, coordinate sequences, symbolic structures — and the system attaches a renderer that turns it into something viewable.
ui_ux_rationale: Adds a deterministic perceptual rendering for otherwise imperceptible output.
definition: The model produces output in a representation the user cannot perceive directly — parameter streams, coordinate sequences, symbolic structures — and the system attaches a renderer that turns it into something viewable. The rendering is not the model's output; it is a display layer chosen by the designer. The user judges the artifact only through that layer.
structural_signature: A rendering stage is inserted between generation and display: the generated representation R is mapped by a fixed, designer-chosen function into a perceptible form V, and only V appears in the interface. The mapping is deterministic and adds no content — everything shown is entailed by R plus fixed rendering assets. Where R is time-varying, V is commonly a sampled sequence laid out spatially. Transplants to sonifying a data stream, plotting a vector, animating a trajectory.

pattern_name: a composite glyph whose parts each encode a named component of one property
short_summary: Rather than reusing a standard chart type, the system introduces a new graphical mark whose geometry is designed around the specific property being communicated.
ui_ux_rationale: Creates a domain-specific graphical mark with explicit component-to-geometry mappings.
definition: Rather than reusing a standard chart type, the system introduces a new graphical mark whose geometry is designed around the specific property being communicated. The mark's parts each carry a distinct component of that property, and the mapping is defined by the paper. The encoding is a contributed object in its own right, described part by part.
structural_signature: A composite graphical mark is defined by an explicit mapping from named components of the data property to named geometric channels of the mark (sector angle, chord endpoint, block extent, static shape standing for a time-varying quantity). The definition is enumerable — the paper can label the parts — and the mark is instantiated once per unit of data. Transplantable in the sense that any property with named components can be given such a mark; but note that what is shared across instances is the *act of designing* a mark, and the marks themselves have nothing structural in common beyond compositeness.
